title: 48:20 Go ye forth of Babylon/the Chaldeans. The Lord promised ancient Israel that after seventy years of Babylonian captivity, Israel would be blessed to return to the land of her inheritance (Jer. 25:11; 29:10). A second meaning is to leave the carnal world for the spiritual. This command has great significance for our day: "When the lost and scattered sheep of Israel find place again in the fold of their Ancient Shepherd, they do so by forsaking the world and joining the true church. They leave the deserts of sin and lie down in the green pastures. They leave Babylon and return to Zion." 26
author: Tina M. Peterson
